products.title: New: Leakproof Undie Covers for Bedtime Protection (4-pack)
products.body_html:
Night-time training is different than Day-time training because it's completely involuntary. When your kiddo has an accident at night, it's completely out of their control.

Accidents aren't their fault, so we just want to minimize cleanups as much as possible:

Which is why we've introduced These NEW Kid Confident Night-time covers!

Simply place these over your kiddo's Kid Confident Training Pants before they go to bed and they'll prevent any sheets from being soiled!

These 100% Nylon covers prevent night-time accidents from leaking out into their bed, ensuring mess-free and stress-free mornings!

products.title: Potty Training Underwear

The key to speeding up the potty training process is making sure your child feels uncomfortable sitting in their pee and poop. The problem is, this means lots of accidents. And speaking from experience - that means soiled car seats, couches, mattresses (do I need to go on?). So, conventional wisdom tells us, "Just throw on some pull-ups in the meantime, they'll absorb the mess, right?" Right. But from someone who has made this mistake 3 times - this only extends the process. Think about it - pullups absorb pee and poop, so your children don't feel they went #1 or #2. Keeping them unaware of the mess they made. So how do we let our children feel they went, without the pain of constant cleanups? That's the exact question one fed-up mom had which led to Kid Confident™ Underwear. These specialized underwear allow your child to feel discomfort of #1 and #2, without the puddles or mess - cutting the time it takes to potty train in half.
